summary.headline: Hyundai India Q2 FY27 revenue hit a record ₹20,696 Mn (+18.5% YoY), but EBITDA margin fell to 9.5% from 13.9% on commodity headwinds.
summary.overview: Domestic volumes rose 18.8% YoY to 165,772 units and total sales hit a record 219,072 units, with exports up 3.7% YoY and 38% QoQ. Revenue reached a record ₹206,961 Mn, but raw material inflation of roughly 400 bps YoY and 250 bps QoQ compressed EBITDA to ₹19,745 Mn and PAT to ₹11,962 Mn (5.7% margin vs 8.9%). Management guided to 8-10% domestic growth and high-double-digit export growth in H2, and a sequential margin recovery toward an 11% full-year EBITDA margin. Bayon launched two days before the call and a dedicated mass-market EV is slated for early CY27.

segments.name: Domestic
segments.commentary: 165,772 units, +18.8% YoY; record rural share of 26.6% and record CNG share of 19.1%. Overall ASP up about 2% YoY; localisation at tier-1 reached 84%.

segments.name: Exports
segments.commentary: Volume up 3.7% YoY and 38% QoQ, 24% of total volume. Q2 mix: Middle East and Africa 52% (Middle East 34%, Africa 18%), Latin America 26%, Mexico 20%.

segments.name: EV
segments.commentary: CRETA Electric drove EV contribution to double QoQ; dedicated mass-market EV due early CY27 (Jan/Feb 2027). Industry EV share about 6-6.5%.

guidance_outlook: FY27 domestic sales growth guidance of 8-10%, with H2 domestic growth of 8-10% YoY.
H2 export growth of high double digits on YoY basis, despite Middle East logistics disruption.
Full-year EBITDA margin guidance of about 11%; management said H2 needs slightly above 12% EBITDA margin to reach it.
Q3 raw material basket expected flat to slightly down QoQ (precious metals falling, copper rising).
Tamil Nadu incentive adds more than 1% to margins in Q3 and Q4; September price hike of 0.4% and about 1.4% taken in CY26 since January.
Bayon CNG launch in January 2027; Bayon exports to start in Q4 FY27; Creta FY27 volume about 170,000 and Creta plus Bayon about 250,000 annual volume.
capex_capacity: Chennai plant utilisation below 80% now; Bayon and the new EV both to be built in Chennai, taking utilisation above 90%.
Third shift at Pune started, bringing output closer to 170,000 units per year.
Pune plant crossed 100k vehicle production; ramp-up completed quickly.
Localisation at tier-1 level 84% in Q2 FY27, up from 82% last year.
PLI: provisional compliance certificate received for Creta; final certificate pending. New EV aims for PLI compliance.
demand_pricing: Management said demand is strong; Shradh plus Navratri sales up 31% YoY and Onam up 75%. Bayon waiting period 2 to 6 months depending on variant, which the company is trying to shorten.
Industry growth expected at about 5-5.5% in H2; company targets 8-10%.
Commodity impact about 400 bps YoY and 250 bps QoQ in Q2; partly offset by localisation, value engineering and price hikes.
Discounts expected to stay controlled in H2 as new models (Bayon, EV) carry little or no discount.
Rural share 26.6%; rural SUV traction about 68-69%, similar to urban.
Export interest from about 50 countries for Bayon (about 34 in Latin America, 14-15 in Middle East).

qa_highlights.question: Bayon capacity needs and timing of the dedicated India EV launch?
qa_highlights.answer: Bayon and the EV will both be built in Chennai, taking utilisation above 90%. Creta plus Bayon seen at 250,000 annual volume, described as conservative. EV launch expected early CY27 (Jan/Feb 2027).

qa_highlights.question: How will export growth reach the guided level, given geopolitical and shipping disruptions?
qa_highlights.answer: H2 high-double-digit export growth is supported by demand, new products (Venue volumes to at least double, Exter at least 50% growth), new markets like Mexico, and alternate Middle East routes and ports with logistics partners.

qa_highlights.question: Q3 discount trend and incremental commodity headwind?
qa_highlights.answer: Discounts 2.9% vs 3.2% YoY; QoQ increase marginal and seasonal. Q3 commodity outlook is hard to quantify given volatility, with copper and plastic rising and precious metals falling.

qa_highlights.question: Demand outlook for H2 and rural trends?
qa_highlights.answer: Demand described as very strong; dealers asking for more cars. Rural remains strong and expected to outpace urban; no major El Nino impact seen so far.

qa_highlights.question: Creta volume outlook and export contribution from Bayon?
qa_highlights.answer: Creta expected at about 170,000 this year. About 50 countries have shown interest in Bayon exports; more clarity expected by the next quarter.

qa_highlights.question: How will H2 EBITDA margin reach the guided level?
qa_highlights.answer: Drivers: Tamil Nadu incentive (over 1% in Q3 and Q4), higher-margin exports, possible raw material softening after US mid-term elections, September and January price hikes, Chennai utilisation recovery, and third-shift fixed-cost leverage.

risks_watch: Commodity inflation (copper, plastics, steel under safeguard duty) could pressure the 11% full-year EBITDA margin target.
Middle East logistics and shipping disruption could keep export growth below the guided high-double-digit H2 rate.
Bayon and EV launch execution and ramp-up; Bayon export potential not yet quantified.
Festive demand conversion and any shift in discounts once the new models ramp.
EV PLI certification for the new model and Creta final certificate pending.
Third-generation Creta timeline not announced; three-wheeler project with TVS and Honda on track, launch timing not yet disclosed.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand and H2 volumes, but cautious on margins and exports. Management repeatedly declined to give Bayon bookings, Creta Gen-3 timing, Q3 commodity numbers or three-wheeler timing, citing early stage or premature announcement.

growth.why: Management guides FY27 domestic sales growth of 8-10% and H2 domestic growth of 8-10% YoY, plus high double-digit H2 export growth, backed by the Pune third shift, Bayon and a Chennai EV launch, though no specific order-book or capacity numbers are given for the H2 volume targets.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: EBITDA margin fell to 9.5% from 13.9% YoY on ~400 bps commodity inflation, but management guides FY27 at ~11% which needs H2 slightly above 12%, helped by Tamil Nadu incentive (>1% in Q3 and Q4) and September/January price hikes, with Q3 commodity basket flat to slightly down QoQ.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.when: Q2 FY27 (done); Q4 FY27 for Chennai EV/Bayon
rows.why: Pune third shift already started, taking output toward ~170,000 units/yr, and Bayon plus the mass-market EV are to be built in Chennai from early CY27 (Jan/Feb 2027), though the Chennai plant sits below 80% utilisation today.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management guides H2 domestic growth of 8-10% YoY and high double-digit H2 export growth, with Q2 domestic volume up 18.8% YoY to 165,772 units and Creta FY27 volume about 170,000.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No new capex amount is disclosed; Chennai utilisation is below 80% and the EV/Bayon build is absorbing spare capacity, so a further capex step is conditional on Bayon and EV volumes reaching the >90% utilisation management expects.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management held the 8-10% domestic and ~11% EBITDA guides and has not signalled an upgrade, while H2 margin needs to exceed 12% from 9.5% in Q2.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: The 11% full-year EBITDA margin requires H2 above 12% against a 9.5% Q2 print, and commodity inflation (copper, plastics, steel safeguard duty) and Middle East shipping disruption could keep exports below the high-double-digit H2 guide.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Bayon launched two days before the call, Bayon CNG is set for January 2027, Bayon exports start in Q4 FY27, and the dedicated mass-market EV is slated for Jan/Feb 2027.

rows.label: Further price hikes to offset commodities
rows.why: September 2026 hike of 0.4% and about 1.4% taken in CY26 since January, and management cited a January price hike as an H2 margin lever.

rows.label: Tamil Nadu incentive lifts margins
rows.why: The Tamil Nadu incentive adds more than 1% to margins in Q3 and Q4, a concrete offset to the 250 bps QoQ commodity hit.

rows.label: Bayon exports and Mexico push
rows.why: Export interest from about 50 countries for Bayon (about 34 in Latin America, 14-15 in Middle East) and Q2 exports up 38% QoQ, with Bayon exports starting Q4 FY27.
